images.title: When the visits meet
images.purpose: Show free gajak days every 7 days and Kabamai's visits every 10 days first meeting on day 70.
images.composition: A single day line runs across the middle with a small shop icon at its left start and a sweet box at day 70 on the right; one train of small hops sits above the line and one of bigger hops below it, with clear white space.
exact_structure: One horizontal grey #6B7280 day line from day 0 to day 70; a small flat shop front icon sits just left of the start.
Above the line: exactly 10 small teal #0072B2 solid hop arcs of equal width, from 0 to 7, 7 to 14, and so on up to 63 to 70; the text Shop: every 7 days sits above this train at its left end.

Below the line: exactly 7 larger amber #E69F00 dashed hop arcs of equal width hanging under the line, from 0 to 10, 10 to 20, and so on up to 60 to 70; the text Kabamai: every 10 days sits below this train at its left end.
Both trains are drawn to the same scale along the day line: each amber hop is 10/7 times as wide as each teal hop, and both trains start at 0.
The hop landing points carry no numbers; the only numbers on the line are 0 at the start and 70 at the end.
At 70 both trains land together on one reddish purple #CC79A7 dot, with a small flat sweet box icon above it and the text Day 70 beside it.
rejection: other than exactly 10 teal hops and 7 amber hops
the two trains landing together anywhere before 70
numbers written at the landing points between 0 and 70
images.takeaway: Two repeating events first happen on the same day at the LCM of their gaps, here 70 days.
images.description: A day line from 0 to 70 with ten 7 day hops above and seven 10 day hops below, both landing together on Day 70 at a sweet box.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video on when Kabamai next gets free gajak.
images.teaching_notes: Count the hops in each train, 10 × 7 and 7 × 10, and notice no landing point matches before 70.

image_decisions.why: Two hop trains on a day line make the first common day visible.
